scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw quantum chemistry artifacts (geometry optimization logs, frequency outputs, CCSD(T) energies) is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. The checker performs a result-level comparison of the agent's reported energy differences and barriers against the paper's Table 2 AVTZ reference values within tolerances, plus qualitative sign/trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper Table 2 AVTZ reference values for P(OH)₃ energy differences and interconversion barriers (kcal/mol)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 in J. Phys. Chem. A 2007, 111, DOI: 10.1021/jp070020o — AVTZ rows for all five structures, four methods, with and without ZPE corrections.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published Table 2; cross-checked against the reference solve.sh which writes identical hardcoded constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers for the exact same quantities, units, and conditions the agent is asked to reproduce. They constitute the authoritative hidden reference for this reproduction task.

outputs.description: Computed relative energies (with respect to C1 isomer) and barrier heights for P(OH)3 isomers at the B3PW91/AVTZ, B3LYP/AVTZ, MP2/AVTZ, and CCSD(T)/AVTZ levels, both with and without ZPE corrections.

output_contract.notes: Only AVTZ results are scored. The agent must compute quantities for all five structures and four methods, with and without ZPE. The checker compares individual values to reference data, checks the sign of the Cs relative energy without ZPE for different methods, and verifies that B3PW91’s mean absolute deviation from CCSD(T) is smaller than B3LYP’s.

checks.description: All 40 reported values (5 structures × 4 methods × 2 ZPE conditions) compared to paper Table 2 AVTZ gold within tolerance (0.3 kcal/mol for non-C1, 0.05 for C1 reference).
Qualitative sign check: Cs relative energy without ZPE must be negative for B3PW91, MP2, CCSD(T) and non-negative for B3LYP.
MAD of B3PW91 energy differences from CCSD(T) must be ≤ MAD of B3LYP energy differences from CCSD(T), computed over Cs and C3 (both ZPE conditions).
